pages.title: Compactification Lathe
pages.text: Rolls extra dimensions up small: Kaluza-Klein circles, Calabi-Yau and G₂ spaces, D-branes and finally M-theory itself.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.

In 1921 Kaluza found that general relativity in five dimensions yields Maxwell's equations for free; Klein explained the fifth as a tiny circle. String theory uses six-dimensional $(thing)Calabi-Yau$() shapes, M-theory seven-dimensional $(thing)G₂$() ones. Here they come out of a lathe.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Compactified Circle, D-Brane Sheet, Dimensional Residue, Graviton Crystal, G₂ Manifold, M-Theory Core, String Coupling Crystal.
